title: Implement unitconv, harden its siunits dependency by killing sealed mutants, then extend
goal: A three-stage campaign chaining tool-from-spec, mutation hardening, and feature extension. Stage 1 implements a unit-conversion module against a sealed acceptance suite. Stage 2 hardens the shipped siunits prefix library: write a behavioral kill-test suite that stays green on the original but fails on at least 12 of its 15 sealed single-change mutants, which requires reading mutant diffs and constructing separating inputs one survivor at a time. Stage 3 extends your module with compound speed units while stage 1 stays green. Plan freezing, a sha256 marker chain over three stages, a run journal, and an honest cost record are graded with final state as one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
assets/gc-411/SPEC.md (conversion factors, mutation-stage rules, artifact contract)
assets/gc-411/siunits.py (sealed mutation target) + assets/gc-411/mutants/ (15 sealed mutants)
process_expectations: A frozen three-stage plan predates implementation and is pinned by the sha256 chain plan -> stage1 -> stage2 -> stage3.
Kill tests probe behavior only: the grader scans work/gc-411/killtests/ for source-introspection tokens and rejects a shipped shadow copy of the target module.
Surviving mutants are worked by identity: runs.log entries across stage 2 show the kill count climbing between grading runs, not a single lucky pass.
The stage-3 feature work does not regress stage 1; the grader re-runs the stage-1 suite last.
cost.json reports honest llm_usd and grader_runs numbers for the whole campaign.
